Name: HIPAA Security Rule & HITECH for OCI
Description: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Security Rule standards for safeguarding electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

Requirements.Name: Security Management Process & Risk Analysis
Requirements.Description: Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations across OCI using Cloud Guard threat detection.

Requirements.Name: Workforce Security & Authorization Management
Requirements.Description: Implement policies and procedures to ensure that all members of its workforce have appropriate access to electronic protected health information.

Requirements.Name: Information Access Management & Least Privilege
Requirements.Description: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to electronic protected health information based on least privilege and role assignment.

Requirements.Name: Security Awareness and Training (Password Hygiene)
Requirements.Description: Implement a security awareness and training program for all members of the workforce including password management and credential rotation.

Requirements.Name: Contingency Plan, Data Backup and Disaster Recovery
Requirements.Description: Establish policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence that damages systems that contain electronic protected health information.

Requirements.Name: Facility Access Controls & Workstation Security
Requirements.Description: Implement policies and procedures to limit physical and logical access to electronic information systems and the facilities in which they are housed.

Requirements.Name: Technical Safeguards: Access Control & Unique User ID
Requirements.Description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights.

Requirements.Name: Technical Safeguards: Encryption and Decryption at Rest
Requirements.Description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information stored on block volumes, boot volumes, and object buckets.

Requirements.Name: Technical Safeguards: Audit Controls & 365-Day Retention
Requirements.Description: Implement mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use electronic protected health information.

Requirements.Name: Technical Safeguards: Integrity & Public Exposure Prevention
Requirements.Description: Implement policies and procedures to protect electronic protected health information from improper alteration or destruction, prohibiting public bucket access.

Requirements.Name: Technical Safeguards: Transmission Security & Network Filtering
Requirements.Description: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
